question: residential roads GeoJSON
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' LIMIT 10;

question: WKT of footways with road surface and name
sql: SELECT ST_AsText(geometry) AS wkt, names.primary AS name, road_surface[1].value AS surface FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' AND road_surface IS NOT NULL AND len(road_surface) > 0 LIMIT 10;

question: centroid lon lat of Avenida da Liberdade
sql: SELECT ROUND(ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry))::DOUBLE, 5) AS lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry))::DOUBLE, 5) AS lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names.primary ILIKE '%Avenida%Liberdade%' LIMIT 1;

question: max speed string for tertiary roads
sql: SELECT CONCAT('Max speed: ', max_speed_s.max_speed.value, ' ', max_speed_s.max_speed.unit) AS speed_label FROM lisbon_roads, UNNEST(speed_limits) AS t(max_speed_s) WHERE class = 'tertiary' AND max_speed_s.max_speed IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10;

question: length metres of steps roads rounded to 2 decimals
sql: SELECT ROUND(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)::DOUBLE, 2) AS length_m FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'steps' LIMIT 10;

question: bounding box GeoJSON of all residential roads
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS bbox_geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential';
